visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a pink sports jersey, lies on a plush white sofa. She interacts playfully with a small brown poodle that jumps onto her chest. The lighting is bright and warm, illuminating a modern living room background with a textured wall. (2) She holds a smartphone to capture a selfie, smiling broadly while the poodle nuzzles her cheek. Subtitles appear at the bottom center. The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the dog looking sad and lying alone on the white cushions. (3) The woman, now wearing a green graphic t-shirt and a grey denim baseball cap, kneels on the floor searching for a white cat near a grey cabinet and a litter box. The lighting remains soft and natural-looking. (4) In a montage, the woman appears stressed, covering her ears and gesturing with her hands while the poodle barks and jumps around her. She is working at a laptop in a different indoor setting with wooden furniture. (5) The camera captures shots of cats and dogs in an animal shelter environment, looking through metal bars of their cages. A volunteer in a green shirt and face mask is seen cleaning the cages and pouring food. (6) The woman returns to the frame, wearing a floral dress, hugging the poodle and the white cat. She smiles warmly at the pets in a bright, modern interior. The video ends with a logo screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Crisis -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a public service announcement to discourage pet abandonment and promote volunteering/adoption. It uses a personal story of a pet owner's struggles to empathize with viewers before showing the harsh reality of animal shelters, finally offering a hopeful solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video concludes with a full-screen logo for TAIWAN SPCA and the Council of Agriculture (農業部), explicitly labeling itself as an advertisement (廣告).

high_inference.freeDescribe: A well-produced PSA using emotional storytelling and real-world shelter footage to drive social engagement for animal welfare.
